name: Drama in the Office
source: You are a photographer for a small agency. You don't know how your boss runs the office since he rarely has a customer. As the story progresses, you find out that the office is just a cover for his dark business. He uses his agency to attract young women. He tells them that he will make them become celebrities. But in fact, he persuades them to become porn actresses.
translation: 你是一家小型经纪公司的摄影师。老板几乎没什么客户，你始终想不通他是怎么把公司经营下去的。随着故事展开，你发现这间办公室只是他见不得光的生意的幌子。他借经纪公司的名义吸引年轻女性，声称能把她们捧成明星，实际上却在劝诱她们成为色情片演员。
